title: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
content_snippet: This summer, OpenAI paused its largest planned frontier training run after its AI agents accidentally hacked Hugging Face and early evidence suggested that its next model could independently find and exploit security flaws. In September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing advances in the most powerful AI models, warning that they could be used […]
title_zh: 还记得前沿AI暂停吗？芯片公司可不记得
summary_zh: 文章指出尽管OpenAI和Anthropic因安全担忧呼吁放慢AI发展，但英伟达等芯片公司仍在大规模生产和销售高性能AI芯片，两者形成鲜明对比。
key_points: OpenAI暂停训练因AI代理意外入侵Hugging Face
Anthropic CEO也呼吁放缓AI进步
芯片公司无视暂停呼声，继续增产高性能芯片

title: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
content_snippet: Like a nasty rash, AI seems to spread everywhere. Google crams AI Overviews down your throat even though it costs the company billions of dollars in lost ad revenue. Leave your apartment, and you might pass two people heaving an AI-powered humanoid robot up the stairs to clean someone’s rooms. Go to the supermarket, and…
title_zh: AI热度指数：人工智能无处不在
summary_zh: 文章以夸张比喻描述了AI技术渗透到生活的方方面面，例如谷歌强行推广AI概览，以及人形机器人被用于清洁房间等现象，反映了AI的过度繁荣。
key_points: AI技术如皮疹般渗透生活各个角落

title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
content_snippet: New NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell and MSI are available today, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC. title: Will Wright’s next game uses AI to map your memories
content_snippet: Will Wright, the creator of legendary franchises like SimCity and The Sims, is working on a new game - and it's built around AI. The new title, focused on your memories, is called MyMems. Like Wright's other titles, it sounds extremely ambitious, giving players a new way to explore worlds they create on their own. […]

content_snippet: Nvidia has stopped sending its advanced AI chips to China despite the approval it received from the White House to do so in December last year. The announcement was made by interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress during an earnings call on Tuesday, marking a notable shift for the company that, under former CEO Jensen Huang, […]

title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t —keep financing neoclouds
content_snippet: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.
title_zh: 英伟达澄清何时会、何时不会为新云服务商提供融资
summary_zh: 英伟达临时CEO澄清，公司为新云服务商的数据中心贷款提供担保是有条件的：需服务商已获独立融资并完成设施建设，且安装了英伟达设备。
key_points: 英伟达融资前提是服务商有独立融资并建成设施

title: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music
content_snippet: Suno has introduced image and video generation in its latest effort to expand beyond being an AI music platform. The new feature, called "Visuals," allows users to turn Suno songs into AI-generated video clips that automatically lipsync to lyrics, or make images via prompt descriptions that can be used as thumbnails and album artwork. Visuals […]
title_zh: Suno 新增 AI 视频功能，可为 AI 音乐生成视频
summary_zh: AI 音乐平台 Suno 推出名为“Visuals”的新功能，允许用户根据歌曲生成 AI 视频片段，能自动匹配口型，或通过提示词制作图像。此举旨在将其服务从音乐拓展至视觉内容领域。

title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
content_snippet: In a lab near Newark Airport in New Jersey, a team of around 30 experienced human sniffers are slowly working their way through every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation…
title_zh: 气味初创公司 Osmo 称其 AI 嗅觉比肩人类
summary_zh: AI 初创公司 Osmo 利用专业嗅探员和化学分析构建训练数据，声称其 AI 嗅觉能力已与人类相当。该技术旨在数字化气味，有巨大应用潜力。
key_points: Osmo 通过人类嗅觉专家和化学分析训练 AI 辨别气味
公司声称其 AI 系统的嗅觉表现已达到人类水平
目标是将气味数字化，应用于多个行业
